The excessive frost possibly make some gap bet ween the cabinet and door gasket, which may cause poor cooling. Remove the frost inside the chamber once a month. AIR INTAKE PORT When a door is closed and opened soon, a door does not sometimes open this product. The warm air which went into the chamber is cooled down rapidly, and this is because air inside the chamber contracted. When a door is closed and opened soon, a door is easy to open with the following process. 1. Turn the cap of the left side counterclockwise about two laps. (That can be removed completely) 2. Put the air into the chamber from about twenty seconds, and open a door. 3. Close a cap if a door opens. A door may not open in the above method when there are frost and ice in the air intake port.
